work.title: Add median(xs) to calc
work.result: Committed b171b2838a6fb7c681140fe64b73a688da78286c. Public signature: median(xs), importable via from calc import median. Accepts any iterable of numbers; sorts input; odd length returns the middle value; even length returns (left_middle + right_middle) / 2; empty input raises ValueError("median of empty sequence"). Added odd, even, unsorted, generator, and empty-input tests. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: all 7 tests passed. Commit uses the existing repository author identity hubdemo <hubdemo@localhost> via command-local settings.
